The blueprint follows the theory note
[`doc/theory/exact-front.md`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/blob/master/doc/theory/exact-front.md)
and links each result to the Lean declarations of `lean/ZenoFront` that formalise it. The badges
follow the claim ledger
[`claims.toml`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/blob/master/claims.toml): a result is
[machine-checked]{.badge .ok} when Lean proves every assertion of it with no axiom beyond
`propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`, [parts in Lean]{.badge .informal} when Lean proves
part of it (one line says what is missing), and [informal]{.badge .informal} otherwise. Each node
opens on its statement; its proof, its remarks and its Lean source are folded under it. The
blueprint is also a [PDF](blueprint.pdf).
